designationHistory.indexText: Establishment of the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 9194—Establishment of the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument, October 10, 2014

review.note: Proclamation 9194, 79 FR 62303, signed 2014-10-10; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President.

designationHistory.indexText: Boundary Enlargement of the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 10746—Boundary Enlargement of the San Gabriel Mountains National Monument, May 02, 2024

review.note: Proclamation 10746, 89 FR 40361, signed 2024-05-02; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President. Antiquities Act reservation of additional land; kept as a modification (a proclamation adding land is a designation under the Act), not treated as a mere boundary revision.
